_README: Dated attestations of the service tier a pass ran at, for passes the committed evidence cannot pin (no batch marker, no run-log tier line, no launch manifest, and billing days that show more than one tier). Read by scripts/lib_pass_cost.py, which prices a pass with no pinning evidence at the HIGHEST candidate tier as an upper bound (cost_basis 'audited-upper-bound') until an entry here pins it. Each entry: id (unique, never reused), run_id (exact), pool (glob over the register's proposer_pool, '*' for every pool), pacific_days (optional list of Pacific-time billing days; when present the entry applies only to a fragment whose every billing day is listed), tier (standard | flex | batch), attested_by ('PI' for the PI's own recollection or records; anything else must name the derivation), attested_on (ISO date), evidence (what the attestation rests on, with citations). Machine evidence outranks an attestation: a run log, batch marker or launch manifest that disagrees wins, and the disagreement is reported in cost_source.conflicts. Append; never edit or delete an entry - supersede it with a new id and say so in its evidence.
